strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: neekyebera ekishumuruzo ekiriho hati n’orunyiriri rw’okusazaho Google (CRL) kandi egyezaho enshonga nyingi kuhitsya obu eratungye ekishumuruzo ekihikire, n’okugaruzaho okwekorera n’okugaruka kutandikaho obuheereza bwa Google. Nikigyendera ahari buri taapu kandi nikyetenga intaneeti (edakiika 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox kuruga aha network: neetunga keybox kuruga omu kitongore (GitHub) kandi ekabiika aha /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Nikyetenga intaneeti kandi neetwara edakiika 1-3. Nikikoresibwa obu smart fetch erikuremwa nari obu keybox yaahindurwa omu ngaro.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP okukyebera: nikikyebera ebicweka by’okuha ebishumuruzo bya Remote ebiriho, nikikyebera TEE omuringo gw’ekihandiiko ky’okuhamya, kandi nikyoreka embeera y’ekikwato kya KmInstallKeybox. Tihariho ekirikuhindura — okureeba embeera y’ekikwato okwa butoosha.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kyebera (okushoma kwonka): nikyoreka Widevine eby’okureeberaho by’omutindo (L1/L3) kuruga omu dumpsys, DRM (IDM) okubaho kwa fairo y’ekishumuruzo, n’ebintu by’enkora ebiine akakwate. Tihariho eki arikuhindura na kakye.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Ekitabo RKP okutereeza: nikigyendesa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ekitabo. Nikishoboorora enshonga z’okuhamya obu passport y’okwekorera erikuremwa. Buri kwiruka nikuhandiika omurongooti gw‘obusinguzi/okuremwa ogurikureebwa gye.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Okutereeza RKP okuijwire: nikugyendera sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh okuijwire. Nikikwata emishango egumire kandi nikitwara obwire buraingwa. Ekirugiremu ekirikureebwa gye nikireebeka aha muheru.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Garuka GMS: nikiihaho amakuru g’obuheereza bwa Play Store na Google (GMS+GSF) kandi kigarukye kitandikireho ekikwato kyonka. Ahabw’okuhamya okugumire kwonka — tikirikukwata aha bishushani byawe nari aha fairo zaawe.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: neekyebera RKP satifikeeti y’okuhamya embeera y’ekikwato kandi egaruraho ebintu by’okuhamya kyaba nikyetengyesa. Tikirikukwata aha data y’omukozesa.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER okuboneza: okutereeza Google omutindo gw‘obuheereza (SOTER) enshonga eziine akakwate n‘okuhamya eby‘okukoresa. Nikikozesibwa aha bikwato ebimwe ebirikwesiga SOTER omu mwanya gw'okuzaana Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Teekaho PIF: ogyende sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh amaani. Nikikozesa enkumu etoorainwe (eky'omu kicweka/eky'omurembe) kandi kigaruza busya pif.prop/pif.json fairo. Ekirugiremu ekirikureebwa gye nikireebeka omu rupapura rw’okuhandiikaho.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF kyebera: nikyoreka embeera ya ingini eteirweho, fairo z’enkumu (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), n’ebihandiiko. Kyebera kwonka — tikiine eki kirikuhindura.
strings.mdCanary: • Okugaruzaho: nikugyendera aha /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Nikireeta Canary Engine eyahererukireyo kureeba ngu yaahikaana n'ebihandiiko bya RKP ebirikwetengyesa (Okwakabiri 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Okukyebera ingini: nikikyebera embeera ya TrickyStoreOSS (pid, ebihandiiko), fairo z’ebishumuruzo (ebirikukora n’ebirikukoresibwa), enkumu z’ekikwato ekihikire n’ekirikuhabisa, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP ebishumuruzo. Okworeka okukyebera kwonka.
strings.hintKbSlots: Omuringo ogu nigutegyeka emyanya ebiri y‘ebishumuruzo: ey‘okubanza (erikwera, etarikusiimurwa) n‘eya kabiri (ey‘okugaruza enyima). Tab egi neeyoreka omwanya ogurikukora, niguhindura eki orikwenda, nari nigutunguura ekya kabiri kuza aha kya kabiri aha kushaba okuhikire — n’ebihandiiko ebirikugarurwa enyima n’ekihandiiko ekiijwire.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Okukyebera oburingaaniza: nikukyebera okureeta ekishumuruzo TEE, okuteebwa omu ibiikiro ry’ebitabo omunda ya keystore2, embeera y’okubinga (CRL), okukingaho orunyiriri rw’oburinzi n’embeera ya RKP. Okushoma kwonka — tihariho eki kirikuhindura.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Orunyiriri rw'obukuumi nirugaruka kwombekwa kuruga ahari buri app eteirweho.
• Omuringo gw'okuhikaana na custom-ROM nigugaruka gukoresibwa.
• Ekibokisi ky'ebishumuruzo ekirikukora nikigaruka kukoresibwa.
#• 0 restarted.

Tihariho ekirikusazibwamu kandi akabokisi k'ekishumuruzo ky'okubanza tikarikukwatwaho.

Gumizamu?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: neeyoreka embeera y’ebicweka by’okubanza n’ebya kabiri kandi neehindura eki orikwenda ahagati yaabyo. Eky'okubanza (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) nikiguma kirindwa kandi tikirikusiimurwa. Okutunguura ekya kabiri kuza omu ky'okubanza nikyetengyesa okuhamibwa okuhikire.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Okutunguura ekicweka kya kabiri kuza omu mwanya gw’okubanza:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml nikihinduka ekicweka ky’okubanza.
• Ekicweka ky’okubanza ekiriho hati nikibiikwa nk’eky’okugaruzaho kitakagarukiremu.
• Tihariho ekirikusazibwamu — omurimo nigugumizamu50##00.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Ihaho omwanya gwa kabiri:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml nigwija kwihwaho.
• Omwanya gw'okubanza tigukwatsirwe.

Gumizamu?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (ensya omu v3.17):

• Nikikyebera ekishumuruzo ekiriho hati n'orunyiriri rw'okubinga Google (CRL).
• Nikigyezaho enshonga nyingi kuhitsya obu ekishumuruzo ekishemeire kirashangwe.
s• Okugarukaho kw'okwekorera +9 obuheereza.

⚠️ Nikyetengyesa intaneeti (edakiika 1-3). Kugumizamu?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Reeta akabokisi k'ebishumuruzo kuruga aha intaneeti:

• Nikitunga akabokisi k'ebishumuruzo obutongore kandi akakihamya.
• Nikiteebwaho obutahwaho (tikigarukiremu aha kutandika).

⚠️ Nikyetenga intaneeti (okuhitsya edakiika 1). Kugumizamu?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Okugaruka kuha RKP ebishumuruzo:

• Tihariho data nari fairo z'ekibokisi ky'ebishumuruzo ezirikusazibwamu.
• Garuka otandikye esimu bwanyima.

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Okuboneza omu bwijwire:

• Okugaruka kuha RKP + kugaruka kutandika Google obuheereza.
• Ekikwato nikigaruka kutandika kyonka (tihariho ekirikusiimurwa).

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Garuka otandikire Google obuheereza:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — garuka otandikire kwonka.
• Tihariho ekirikusiimurwa kandi TORIKWIJA kuruga omu simu.
• Ekikwato nikigaruka kyatandika kyonka.#000e#65
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Okugaruka kuha amaani (Red Magic):

• Aha bikwato ebitarikufayo aha kabokisi k'ebishumuruzo akavugire.
• Nikikora n'obu ebishumuruzo biraabe biine amagara marungi.
• Tihariho data erikusazibwamu.

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmCertify:
Okugyema Play Store okuha orusa:

• Nikiihaho ekicweka kya Store kyonka — akawunti yaawe tekwatsirweho.
• Garuka otandikye, reero oigureho Store.

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER okuboneza:

• Nikigaruka kitandika obuheereza bwa vendor.soter.
• Nikiihaho SOTER data ya saava yonka.

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Teekaho akabonero k'enkumu (PIF):

• Nikihindura custom.pif.prop kandi kikita omu muhanda gwa ingini.
• Nikyetengyesa kugaruka kutandika bwanyima.

Gumizamu?
strings.confirmCanary:
Okugaruzaho enkumu za Canary:

• Nikitunga enkumu ya Canary ensya kuruga ahari Google.
• Nikikwatanisa ekikwato ky'okwerinda + nikigaruka kitandikaho obuheereza bwa Google (tihariho kusiimura).

⚠️ min.3). Kugumizamu?
